text: Marshal-Captain Elias Drayen holds the role of Sentinel Special Operations Commander within Galactic Union (federation). Decision archetype: Tactical Precision, Direct Action Specialist.

Core traits: Brilliant Tactician, Fearless in Combat, Loyal to the Marshals, Uncompromising. Voice — tone: commanding; cadence: staccato. Avoids: ambiguity, unnecessary exposure, deviation from mission parameters.
Assigned to G.U.S. Judicator Prime (Galactic Union Supercarrier). Core values: mission integrity, tactical precision, marshal doctrine. Faction — military: 0.80, economic: 0.80, technology: 0.70.
